mapper.sql: SELECT mc.card_id AS cardId, mc.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, mc.member_id AS memberId, COALESCE(m.real_name, m.nickname) AS memberName, m.mobile AS memberMobile, mc.plan_id AS planId, p.plan_name AS planName, mc.card_no AS cardNo, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.plan_type AS planType, mc.bind_coach_id AS bindCoachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, mc.active_time AS activeTime, mc.expire_time AS expireTime, mc.total_times AS totalTimes, mc.used_times AS usedTimes, mc.remain_times AS remainTimes, mc.balance_amount AS balanceAmount, mc.card_status AS cardStatus, mc.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, mc.remark AS remark, mc.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: ORDER BY mc.create_time DESC, mc.card_id DESC
ORDER BY mc.create_time DESC, mc.card_id DESC

FROM fit_member_card mc INNER JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = mc.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = mc.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_card_plan p ON p.plan_id = mc.plan_id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = mc.bind_coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_order o ON o.order_id = mc.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.card_id = #{cardId} LIMIT 1
